explanations.title: Publish review check runs
explanations.summary: Adds a reusable check-run lifecycle publisher: callers can create an in-progress check for a review and complete it with a result. Completed checks include a `retry_review` action.

explanations.title: Make P0 check failures configurable
explanations.summary: A P0 finding yields a failing check only when `failOnP0` is enabled; otherwise the result is neutral.

explanations.title: Accept check-run events
explanations.summary: The webhook receiver now accepts `check_run` deliveries, so GitHub can send check-run events to the app for normal processing.
